assertions.assertion: Takes the light path and starts no KB
assertions.evidence: The agent never called orbit-kb or created a KB. It went straight from reading greet.py and test_greet.py to editing them, and its delivery says "Triggers: none. This was a one-line change with a clear request."

assertions.assertion: Changes the check first and sees it fail, then builds
assertions.evidence: It first edited test_greet.py to expect "Hello, Ana!". After a run that errored because of the `-I` flag, it reran the test and got "FAILED (failures=1)" with the diff `- Hi Ana / + Hello, Ana!`. Only then did it edit greet.py, and the test then passed with OK.
The final delivery message contains the line "KB: No KB".
